name: MiniMax H3 (Official)
description: Official Draw Things preset for MiniMax H3 video model
notes: VIDEO MODEL: MiniMax H3 (minimax_h3_fl2va_i4x.ckpt) generates video with audio at 832x512. 50 steps official; the FastH3 Omni build wants 8 (see fasth3_omni preset). Supporting up to 362 frames. Accepts reference images. Tiled decoding OFF: the 256px tile values in the phone export describe local hardware, not the model. 73 frames ~= 3s at 25fps.
